text.content:
Cartoon heroines who shelter anyone running from a "loved one".

Turf: Princessland, Wellsprings
Known for: Sheltering victims of abuse, in costume
Leadership: Adorable, in her sixties and still in the costume
Allies & rivals: Patron: the Valentinos. They send the cases they can't hold to Lizzie's Bar

Still dressed as the heroines of an old cartoon, and still sheltering anyone running from a "loved one" at Princessland in Wellsprings, as they did in 2045. The Don respects the cause, so the Valentinos make sure nobody follows a runaway through Princessland's door.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.04
